unit.why: A brief anecdote: R. Moshe of Ludmir, who did not usually say Torah in public, was pressed to do so and answered with an exegesis that showed his humility.

stories.summary_en: R. Moshe of Ludmir, who avoided saying Torah in public, was urged to speak and explained through Rashi that only one who can address each listener at his own level may say Torah; in his humility he declared that he could not.

quotes: ומרוב ענותנותו אמר אני אין יכול
tags.why: His refusal is explicitly attributed to humility
The anecdote illustrates the tzaddik's humility

quotes: בקשו והפצירו אותו מאוד לומר תורה
